record.publishedIn: Linnaeus, C. v. 1753: Species plantarum. – Holmiae

descriptions.description: Annual. Leaves 3-8 cm, narrowly oblong, pinnatifid, often runcinate, glabrous or sparsely mealy. Scapes 4-6 cm, often procumbent, usually swollen below capitulum. Phyllaries glabrous or mealy; outer ovate, c. 2 mm; inner oblong-lanceolate, 7-10 mm; in fruit ± erect. Achenes 7-8 mm, glabrous or puberulent, outer with pappus of short thick hairs, inner with pappus of lanceolate scales and a few hairs. Fl. 3-7.\r\rfrom: Matthew, V. A. 1975: 101. Hyoseris – Pp. 631-632 in: Davis, P.H. et al (ed.), Flora of Turkey 5. – Edinburgh.
